notes.title: NEW DEMO
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey there, fellow chicken fans![/b] [b]🐣[/b][/h3][p]

notes.title: ChickSynth-9000 - Ultimate Chick Accelerator Machine
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, fellow chicken fans! 🐣[/b]

Over the past month, we’ve been working on a brand-new ultimate chicken-growing accelerator — the [b]ChickSynth-9000[/b] (not without the help of our clever she-goblin Girka, of course).

Growing chickens in a focused way has never been easier! And the little surprise elements will surely bring a smile to your face.

notes.title: Huge Farm Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, fellows! [/b]🐣

These past few weeks, we've done a lot of work!
We’ve completely revamped the farm—redesigned the chicken walking area, changed the fence, improved the crafting corner, and added a whole bunch of new devices to help every professional chicken breeder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333221/2af35ebfe24f5f69a0e862e6684eefb4af2062dc.jpg[/img]

You can now grow your own plants in the garden bed, convert chicken poop into energy, and see the exact amount of feed left in the chick feeder.
We’ve also updated the game trailer and screenshots—hope you’ll like them!

[b]See you soon!
Yours,
FireLog Studios 🐣👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨[/b]

notes.title: The brand-new Chicken'oTron 3000
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, fellow chicken fans! 🐣[/b]


In the last two weeks, we made a new way to produce and deliver eggs and baby chicks.

Now, the chicken farm has a new machine called Chicken'oTron 3000– a reliable friend for any professional chicken breeder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333221/c89a2706cd5076194da3a9725c5c525a29459432.gif[/img]

We are also continuing our work on the farm's appearance and the tutorial.

Don't miss us too much. We'll be back with some exciting updates on the development!


Yours,
[b]FireLog Studios 🐣👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨[/b]

notes.title: Devlog January 2025
notes.content:

notes.title: New Character Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, fellow chicken fans![/b] 🐣

We’re Luni Tuni and Gwiz, the team of FireLog Studios, and we’re here to wish you all the happiest holidays—[u][b]Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year![/b][/u] 🎄❄️

For the upcoming year, we wish you nothing but the very best! And of course, we’ve got a little gift for you under the tree. 🎁

Over the past few weeks, we’ve been hard at work creating a new and special character just for you—meet [u][b]Kolka, our she-goblin guide[/b][/u]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333221/ac5a2ef6b8a41d1031747f2ff08752a3624b2f96.png[/img]

Kolka is a cheerful and quirky engineer-slash-scientist who built our high-tech chicken farm from scratch. She’ll show you how everything works and introduce you to the fantasy world of our game.

We hope you’ll love her as much as we do!



Once again, happy holidays!
See you next year,
The FireLog Studios Team 🎅

notes.title: Farm Appearance Updates
notes.content:
[b]Hey, fellow chicken admirers 🐣 [/b]

We want to let you know all of our news on the development of our wholesome chicken craft sim. 

We've been working hard on improving the look of our farm these past few weeks.

So, we`ve decided to make a few changes to it.
We decided our farm needed [u]more zoning[/u], so we divided the space with different fences. We also [u]updated the farmhouse[/u] and set aside a separate [u]area for a future craft zone and garden[/u]. But we still need to get those stuff done of course =)

Just look at how much these small changes have transformed the look of the farm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333221/958c790f7e999132793dcc9e2c3436db4382e82b.png[/img]

Don't miss us too much, we'll be back in 2 weeks with some new exciting updates on how the development is going!


Yours, Luni Tuni and Gwiz 👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨
